title: Cigarette lighters and other lighters; smoking pipes and cigar or cigarette holders, and parts thereof; combs, hair-slides and the like; hairpins, curling pins, curling grips, hair-curlers and the like (except electro-thermic apparatus), and parts thereof; scent sprays and similar toilet sprays, and mounts and heads therefor; powder-puffs and pads for the application of cosmetics or toilet preparations

review.classification: The explicit comb class covers this complete passive hair comb. The scope excludes brushes, electrothermic devices, other materials and constructions, and repackaging of bought finished combs.
review.route: Whole unfilled virgin PP, one solid injection-moulded part through first bare-comb quality release. Manufacturer family and product evidence support the selection without identifying a shared SKU or assumed virgin formulation.
review.measurement: Calibrated net mass of uniquely first-released complete parts. Distinct gross physical and environmental vectors, separate original-cohort service, single normalization and no quotient when first release is zero.
review.allocation: Dedicated operations and subdivision first, then exchange-specific causal drivers. Only the remaining inseparable share permits actual common-gate market evidence.
review.bilingual: EN/Chinese review found aligned scope, process identities, first-release basis, stock transfers, sensitivity and collection requirements. Concrete reference and unverified flows remain explicitly unresolved. The scientific and translation review flags remain pending.
